stem:
Three different species of plants that live in the desert are shown.

Species Z can successfully share the same environment with the other plants shown because species Z absorbs water —

options.label: A
options.text: found deep underground, and species X absorbs water near the soil surface

options.label: B
options.text: found deep underground, and species X absorbs water found deep underground

options.label: C
options.text: near the soil surface, and species Y absorbs water near the soil surface

options.label: D
options.text: near the soil surface, and species Y absorbs water found deep underground

visual_elements: Diagram of three plants labeled Species X, Species Y, Species Z with roots at different soil depths.
